title: Navigate from canonical evidence to a pedagogical concept
purpose: Demonstrate that a presenter can move from the conference surface to the bounded Study 0 result and then open the PCA explanation without changing the scientific claim.
preconditions: The bundled Study 0 claim C-NI-001 is available.
E2E evidence mode is enabled for the qualification run only.

messages.label: Open / ⇒ presenter + claim visible
messages.expected: Presenter loads and claim area is visible

messages.label: Emit open/evidence ⇒ correlated to root
messages.expected: open + evidence spans are correlated to root

messages.label: Read PCA ⇒ explanation linked C-NI-001
messages.expected: PCA explanation stays linked to C-NI-001

messages.label: Emit concept ⇒ span + log + exemplar
messages.expected: PCA span + correlated log + metric exemplar

messages.label: OTLP ⇒ GET root SpanId recovers subtree
messages.expected: GET root SpanId recovers complete expected subtree

steps.title: Open the conference surface
expected: The application title is Interactive Evidence Presenter.
The wording states that corrected Study 0 did not demonstrate non-inferiority.

steps.title: Navigate to Study 0
expected: The visible H1 is Compression did not demonstrate non-inferiority.
The telemetry navigation span records mission -> study-0 with action next.

steps.title: Open the PCA pedagogical descent
expected: Emma explains PCA as an unsupervised linear projection.
The concept span remains linked to claim C-NI-001.

steps.title: Recover and verify runtime evidence
steps.action: Flush OTLP signals and query the evidence bundle by the Playwright root SpanId.
expected: All expected spans and parent relationships are recovered.
Expected structured logs are correlated to the correct spans.
Interaction-duration metrics contain exemplars correlated to the navigation and concept spans.
The executable telemetry contract verdict is PASS.
